title: Ranking Is Not Deciding: Benchmark Shortcuts and Operating-Point Collapse in Query-Time RAG Poisoning Defenses
abstract: arXiv:2610.33849v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Query-time filters that screen each retrieved document before it reaches the generator are the dominant published defense against retrieval-augmented generation poisoning, and they report near-perfect detection on domain benchmarks. We show that this performance is predicted by how the poison set was built rather than by what the filter reads: removing a single construction cue destroys the deployed decision before it destroys the ranking. Two label-free statistics of a poison set and its clean corpus profile the cue: containment, how often the target question appears verbatim in the poison, and length overlap. PoisonedRAG's released code prepends the target question to every inserted passage. Of the 21 published defense evaluations we survey, 8 verifiably run poison built this way and 5 substitute a length cue; separately, 12 report no false-positive rate at the operating point they deploy. translated_title: 排序不等于决策：查询时RAG投毒防御中的基准捷径与工作点崩溃
translated_abstract: 在检索增强生成（RAG）系统中，对每篇检索到的文档在其进入生成器之前进行筛查的查询时过滤器，是目前已发表的主流防御RAG投毒攻击的方法，且它们在领域基准上报告了近乎完美的检测效果。我们证明这种性能是由投毒集的构建方式决定的，而非过滤器实际读取的内容：移除单一的构建线索，即可在破坏排序之前先摧毁已部署的决策。两个无需标签的统计量可以刻画该线索：包含度，即目标问题在投毒文档中逐字出现的频率，以及长度重叠度。PoisonedRAG发布的代码将目标问题前置于每条插入的段落之前。在我们调查的21项已发表的防御评估中，有8项可验证地使用了以这种方式构建的投毒集，另有5项以长度线索替代；此外，有12项在其实际部署的工作点处未报告任何假阳性率。仅仅从攻击中删除该前缀……（原文摘要至此被截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示现有查询时RAG投毒防御的近完美检测性能主要源于投毒集构建中的捷径线索（如将目标问题逐字前置于投毒文档），移除该线索后排序看似完好但部署决策已先崩溃，且多数已发表评估存在构建方式依赖和假阳性率报告缺失的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the near-perfect detection of query-time RAG poisoning defenses stems from construction shortcuts in benchmark poison sets (e.g., verbatim question prefixes) rather than what filters actually read; removing a single construction cue collapses the deployed decision operating point before the ranking degrades, while most published evaluations omit false-positive rates.
